Bruna Zamith

Staff Data Scientist · PhD Candidate in Artificial Intelligence

Computer Engineer and PhD candidate working as a Staff Data Scientist on the Data Ads team at iFood.

My research focuses on applying Machine Learning to the Natural Sciences. I am also interested in software engineering, distributed systems, and natural computing.

In my spare time, you can find me reading a good book, riding my bicycle, enjoying a cup of coffee or (hopefully!) traveling.
